purpose: Time-sensitive lifecycle overlay for the generative provider catalog. Read this before investing in a new adapter or routing to a model whose product/API lifecycle changed after the base catalog was authored.

overrides.rule: Do not begin a new Sora API adapter for this Creative Engine. Existing API routing knowledge may remain for historical/temporary awareness until the sunset date, but should not be recommended as strategic production infrastructure.

Do not invoke from this repository until MiniMax's official API reference exposes a concrete H3 model identifier/endpoint and a governed adapter is implemented. Current public video-generation API docs still enumerate Hailuo 2.3 family models for the existing endpoint.

routingRules: Lifecycle overrides outrank stale capability profiles.
A newly announced model is not executable merely because the vendor website offers an API button; require concrete current API model/endpoint documentation.
A scheduled-sunset model should not receive new adapter investment unless the user explicitly requests short-lived migration work.
Revalidate this file before enabling any new generative-video adapter.
